/* === EXPLORATION MODE V1 — tutorial preserved, research launcher reuses the same left panel === */ #explorationPanelFx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:72;pointer-events:none;display:none} #explorationPanelFx.on{display:block} .explore-learned-row{position:absolute;border-radius:26px;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,6,42,.42),rgba(15,7,52,.58));box-shadow:inset 0 0 28px rgba(11,5,40,.34);transition:opacity .25s ease} .explore-learned-row:after{content:"✓";position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;width:34px;height:34px;transform:translateY(-50%);display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;border:1.7px solid rgba(255,224,137,.92);background:radial-gradient(circle at 42% 35%,rgba(83,48,148,.98),rgba(28,13,71,.98) 68%);color:#fff1b7;font:700 24px/1 Georgia,serif;text-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(255,205,84,.9);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,198,69,.46),0 0 21px rgba(129,77,225,.30),inset 0 0 9px rgba(255,238,185,.10)} #exploreLaunchHub{position:absolute;pointer-events:auto;border-radius:27px;border:2px solid rgba(255,221,132,.96);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(33,17,87,.94),rgba(18,8,59,.98));box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px rgba(130,82,228,.23),0 0 12px rgba(255,199,70,.40);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 8px;overflow:visible;isolation:isolate} #exploreLaunchHub:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:5px;border-radius:21px;border:1px solid rgba(255,236,181,.28);pointer-events:none} #exploreLaunchHub .research-target-badge{position:absolute;right:-9px;top:-15px;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px solid rgba(255,225,143,.98);background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 34%,rgba(77,42,143,.98),rgba(22,9,64,.99) 70%);color:#ffe8a7;font:italic 700 24px/1 Georgia,serif;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,194,63,.86);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,196,64,.55),0 0 20px rgba(123,74,226,.38);z-index:5} .explore-launch-btn{position:relative;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,224,147,.80);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(74,39,142,.94),rgba(35,16,88,.98));color:#ffe7a0;border-radius:17px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px;padding:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 11px rgba(255,239,191,.07),0 0 8px rgba(132,86,233,.25);transition:transform .14s ease,filter .14s ease,box-shadow .14s ease,border-color .14s ease;touch-action:manipulation} .explore-launch-btn:hover,.explore-launch-btn:focus-visible{outline:none;transform:translateY(-1px) scale(1.035);filter:brightness(1.16);border-color:rgba(255,235,176,.98);box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(255,240,197,.12),0 0 10px rgba(255,198,66,.38),0 0 21px rgba(140,86,244,.35)} .explore-launch-btn.side{width:50px;height:50px} .explore-launch-btn.all{width:74px;height:61px;border-radius:20px;border-width:2px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,rgba(126,75,207,.98),rgba(47,20,112,.98) 68%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(255,241,196,.11),0 0 10px rgba(255,198,69,.45),0 0 22px rgba(145,88,244,.36)} .explore-launch-btn .mini-label{font:700 10px/1 Arial,sans-serif;color:rgba(255,238,190,.94);white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.1px} .explore-launch-btn.all .mini-label{font-size:12px;color:#fff2c0} .explore-launch-btn .arrow-glyph{font:900 25px/22px Arial,sans-serif;color:#fff0b6;text-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(255,199,68,.88)} .explore-launch-btn.all .arrow-glyph{font-size:34px;line-height:29px;letter-spacing:-7px;padding-right:6px} .explore-launch-btn .people-glyph{position:relative;width:30px;height:25px} .explore-launch-btn .people-glyph i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:#ffe5a0;box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(255,201,74,.72)} .explore-launch-btn .people-glyph i:nth-child(1){width:9px;height:9px;left:10px;top:0} .explore-launch-btn .people-glyph i:nth-child(2){width:7px;height:7px;left:2px;top:5px} .explore-launch-btn .people-glyph i:nth-child(3){width:7px;height:7px;right:2px;top:5px} .explore-launch-btn .people-glyph:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;right:2px;bottom:0;height:12px;border-radius:11px 11px 5px 5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d99bff,#ffe5a0,#d99bff);box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(177,108,255,.45)} .explore-launch-btn.babies .people-glyph{transform:scale(.82)} .explore-launch-btn.babies .people-glyph i{background:#ffd4fa;box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(219,120,255,.65)} .explore-launch-btn.babies .people-glyph:after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#bf78ff,#ffd4fa,#bf78ff)} /* g research keeps the exact same launcher geometry; only the active target language changes. */ #explorationPanelFx.g-mode #exploreLaunchHub{border-color:rgba(231,196,255,.98);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(88,30,150,.98),rgba(39,11,92,.99));box-shadow:inset 0 0 26px rgba(211,151,255,.23),0 0 13px rgba(222,161,255,.70),0 0 29px rgba(123,59,244,.52)} #explorationPanelFx.g-mode #exploreLaunchHub:before{border-color:rgba(246,223,255,.40)} #explorationPanelFx.g-mode .research-target-badge{border-color:#efcaff;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 34%,#bd65f1,#511193 72%);color:#fff0ff;text-shadow:0 0 8px #e3a9ff;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(229,171,255,.85),0 0 28px rgba(134,69,255,.62)} #explorationPanelFx.g-mode .explore-launch-btn{border-color:rgba(237,206,255,.92);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(145,67,211,.98),rgba(67,20,132,.99));color:#fff0ff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 13px rgba(248,224,255,.12),0 0 10px rgba(215,150,255,.45)} #explorationPanelFx.g-mode .explore-launch-btn.all{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,rgba(211,118,247,.98),rgba(94,29,168,.99) 68%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px rgba(255,237,255,.16),0 0 14px rgba(239,180,255,.78),0 0 31px rgba(136,69,255,.62);animation:exploreAllPulse 1.15s ease-in-out infinite alternate} #explorationPanelFx.g-mode .explore-launch-btn .arrow-glyph,#explorationPanelFx.g-mode .explore-launch-btn .mini-label{color:#fff1ff;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(230,174,255,.92)} @keyframes exploreAllPulse{from{filter:brightness(.98)}to{filter:brightness(1.16)}}\n/* Fresh f research cue: the existing central ALL launcher is the next action. */\n#explorationPanelFx.f-ready #exploreLaunchHub{border-color:rgba(255,226,134,1);box-shadow:inset 0 0 26px rgba(155,101,248,.24),0 0 15px rgba(255,201,67,.62),0 0 30px rgba(126,83,244,.42)}\n#explorationPanelFx.f-ready .explore-launch-btn.all{filter:brightness(1.13);border-color:rgba(255,239,183,1);background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 36%,rgba(151,91,231,.99),rgba(55,23,126,.99) 70%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 17px rgba(255,245,207,.16),0 0 15px rgba(255,204,72,.78),0 0 33px rgba(148,91,250,.52);animation:fResearchReadyPulse .88s ease-in-out infinite alternate}\n#explorationPanelFx.f-ready .research-target-badge{filter:brightness(1.16);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,205,80,.76),0 0 25px rgba(132,80,236,.46)}\n@keyframes fResearchReadyPulse{from{transform:scale(1);filter:brightness(1.06)}to{transform:scale(1.045);filter:brightness(1.25)}}\n#explorationPanelFx.f-ready.g-mode .explore-launch-btn.all{animation:exploreAllPulse 1.15s ease-in-out infinite alternate}\n /* In exploration mode the old four hotspots stop taking pointer input. The core handlers remain the single action source and are called programmatically by the hub. */ #stage.exploration-mode #panelHits .hit{pointer-events:none!important}
